title: National Lampoon's Van Wilder: The Rise of Taj
full_review:
"National Lampoon's Van Wilder: The Rise of Taj" (Bauer Martinez Entertainment) is the sophomore installment in the "Van Wilder" series, and it is indeed sophomoric.

Here, American college student Taj Mahal Badalandabad (played again by Kal Penn) crosses the pond to continue his academic and partying pursuits at a prestigious English university where he inspires a group of campus outcasts (Glenn Barry, Anthony Cozens, Steve Rathman and Holly Davidson) to take on some snooty bluebloods in a fraternal competition.

In this "Animal House"-on-the-Thames, director Mort Nathan offers a witless syllabus of raunchy frat-house humor that depicts college life as little more than an opportunity for sex and booze.

The film contains pervasive vulgar sexual humor, crass sight gags, partial frontal nudity, much crude language and an instance of profanity. The USCCB Office for Film & Broadcasting classification is O -- morally offensive. The Motion Picture Association of America rating is R -- restricted. Under 17 requires accompanying parent or adult guardian.
